issue_context.title: Add feature flag support for placement rules
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

This is a subtask of https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/18030

A feature flag has already been added in https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/21833

We just need to ensure that it is respected correctly prior to code freeze because placement is an experimental feature, not GA.

review_comments: I found the name `tidb_enable_alter_placement` is a little misleading now. Actually it means "wether enable placement or not", not just for alter. Should we modify the variable name now ? @morgo
Because we'll finally remove the variable before GA, I think it's fine to keep its name unchanged.
Discussed on Slack: Because the flag name is pre-existing, I think we should keep it. Otherwise, we'll end up with 2 flags. We will remove the flag once we GA anyway.
